metadata.status: Verified Technical Design Review (Non-Energized / Zero Hardware Connected)

Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.device_classification: Integrated Energy Metering IC with mSure Autocalibration
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.accuracy_specifications: Class 1.0 and Class 2.0 active energy standards compliance (IEC 62053-21, ANSI C12.20); typical 0.1% active energy error over 3000:1 dynamic range with shunt resistor and mSure autocalibration
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.low_current_limitations: Current Channel A supports full-scale input down to 26.04 mV peak (18.4 mV RMS at 16x gain). With a 1 mOhm shunt, full scale is 18.4 A RMS, resolving currents below 5 mA (~1.1 W at 230 V). With external CT on Channel B, phase shift at < 100 mA degrades without calibration
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.sampling_and_update_behavior: Three 24-bit Sigma-Delta ADCs operating at 88 dB SNR. High-speed DSP accumulates half-cycle RMS every 10 ms (at 50 Hz). Continuous register streaming or 1.0s periodic polling
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.digital_interface: SPI slave mode (up to 10 MHz clock rate, 4-wire) with CRC-16 register validation and interrupt pin (IRQ)
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.calibration_requirements: mSure autocalibration directly measures sensor stability and signal path gain using on-chip precision test current injection; eliminates external reference calibration rig for shunt drift
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.isolation_and_safety_limitations: CRITICAL: IC ground is tied directly to AC mains line/neutral shunt potential. Non-isolated. REQUIRES external galvanic digital isolator (e.g. TI ISO7741 or ADI ADuM1401 rated >= 2.5 kV RMS) between ADE9153A and host microcontroller. Evaluation board EV-ADE9153ASHIELDZ does NOT include onboard isolation (UG-1253 Section 1)
Analog_Devices_ADE9153A.approximate_cost_usd: IC alone: $4.50 - $7.00 USD (DigiKey/Mouser in single units); Official Evaluation Shield (EV-ADE9153ASHIELDZ): $75.00 - $95.00 USD

Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.accuracy_specifications: Less than 0.1% active energy error over 4000:1 dynamic range; batch factory gain error < 1%, enabling calibration-free designs with high-precision shunts
Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.low_current_limitations: Current channel input range: 10 mA to 30 A RMS with 1 mOhm shunt. Anti-creep threshold automatically forces output to zero when current falls below no-load threshold
Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.sampling_and_update_behavior: Two 24-bit Sigma-Delta ADCs. Internal registers refresh every ~200 ms
Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.digital_interface: Pin-selectable UART (4800 to 38400 baud, 8N1) or SPI (up to 900 kHz clock, 24-bit frame length)
Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.calibration_requirements: Factory pre-calibrated gain allows calibration-free operation for Class 1.0 meters if precision external 1 mOhm shunt (0.5% tolerance) and divider resistors (0.1% tolerance) are used
Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.isolation_and_safety_limitations: Non-isolated ground plane referenced to AC mains. REQUIRES external optocouplers for host UART connection if host is not fully isolated or battery powered
Shanghai_Belling_BL0942.approximate_cost_usd: IC alone: $0.60 - $1.20 USD (LCSC); Pre-assembled smart plugs containing BL0942: $9.00 - $15.00 USD

Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.device_classification: Complete Enclosed AC Power/Energy Metering Module with Split-Core CT
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.manufacturer: Ningbo Peacefair Electronic Co., Ltd. (Zhejiang, China)
quantities_measured: Active Power (W, 0.1 W resolution, 0 to 23 kW)
RMS Voltage (V, 0.1 V resolution, 80 to 260 VAC)
RMS Current (A, 0.001 A resolution, 0 to 100 A with external CT)
Active Energy (kWh, 1 Wh resolution below 10 kWh)
Line Frequency (Hz, 0.1 Hz resolution, 45 to 65 Hz)
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.accuracy_specifications: Headline +/- 0.5% for Voltage, Current, Active Power, and Energy; +/- 1.0% for Power Factor under standard resistive calibration conditions (220 VAC, 50 Hz, 10A)
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.low_current_limitations: Current starting threshold: 0.02 A (~4.6 W at 230 V). Below 0.02 A, current register reads exactly 0.000 A. Power starts measuring at 0.4 W. Severe phase shift error (+/- 0.08 in PF) at currents below 0.2 A due to split-core CT core permeability degradation
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.sampling_and_update_behavior: Internal metering core (SD3004 / V9881) samples continuously and updates internal Modbus registers every 200 ms to 500 ms. Master polling should occur at 1.0s to 2.0s. Polling faster than 200 ms yields cached duplicate values
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.digital_interface: TTL UART (9600 bps, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity) implementing a subset of Modbus-RTU protocol (Function code 0x04 Read Input Registers)
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.calibration_requirements: Factory calibrated by Peacefair with paired CT. No user gain/phase calibration registers available over Modbus protocol
Peacefair_PZEM_004T_v3.isolation_and_safety_limitations: BUILT-IN optocoupler isolation (PC817 optocouplers) isolates TTL UART pins from high-voltage mains circuitry. Safe to interface directly to 3.3V/5V microcontroller UART. However, the AC screw terminals (live and neutral) and auxiliary power supply operate at mains line potential and require non-conductive protective enclosure

Espressif_ESP32_WROOM_32E.role_in_energy_mirror: Digital Communications Controller & Telemetry Edge Gateway (REST Ingest Client, SNTP Timestamp Synchronizer, SPI/UART Master)
Espressif_ESP32_WROOM_32E.operating_conditions: Supply voltage: 3.0 V to 3.6 V (3.3 V nominal); Operating current: typ 80 mA (peaks to 500 mA during RF transmission); Ambient temperature: -40 C to +85 C
Espressif_ESP32_WROOM_32E.adc_performance_and_limitations: CRITICAL FINDING: Onboard 12-bit SAR ADC exhibits severe Differential Non-Linearity (DNL: -7 to +7 LSB) and Integral Non-Linearity (INL: -12 to +12 LSB). Highly non-linear below 100 mV and above 2450 mV. MUST NEVER be used for direct analog current/voltage sensing for NILM. Dedicated external 24-bit metering IC is mandatory
Espressif_ESP32_WROOM_32E.digital_interfaces_used: Hardware SPI (VSPI/HSPI) up to 10 MHz for ADE9153A; Hardware UART (UART1/UART2) at 9600 bps for PZEM-004T; Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n (2.4 GHz) for TLS/HTTP POST to FastAPI backend
Espressif_ESP32_WROOM_32E.time_synchronization_capabilities: Hardware SNTP client synchronizes UTC epoch time with millisecond precision over local network NTP server; drifts < 50 ms between periodic resynchronization pings

the_12w_low_power_measurement_budget.evaluation_context: Investigating whether a 12 W LED bulb transition can be detected from whole-house aggregate mains measurements

instrument_total_power_accuracy_budget.analysis: Even an instrument operating at 0.5% Class accuracy incurs a +/- 4.0 W to +/- 10.0 W uncertainty band on typical background loads, which constitutes 33% to 83% of the 12 W signal itself.

grid_voltage_sag_sensitivity.background_load_dependence: Resistive/thermal baseline obeys P = V^2 / R
grid_voltage_sag_sensitivity.analysis: A minor 1.0% grid voltage sag on an 800 W household load produces a 16.0 W drop, which is 133% of the entire 12 W bulb signal. Without cycle-synchronous voltage compensation, aggregate active power cannot differentiate an LED turn-on from grid voltage recovery.

ct_magnetizing_knee_distortion.analysis: At 61.4 mA, split-core CTs operate below their linear excitation threshold. Magnetizing current causes severe phase displacement, corrupting active vs reactive power separation.

ambient_electronic_noise_floor_w.analysis: An SNR of 2.0 in Gaussian noise guarantees that random baseline fluctuations repeatedly breach the [8, 16] W envelope, generating over 36 false alarms per hour.

question_1_total_power_accuracy.evidence: Modern 24-bit metering ICs (ADE9153A, BL0942) easily measure total aggregate household power with Class 1.0 (< 1.0% error) accuracy.

question_2_resolve_small_power_change.evidence: With 0.1 W register resolution and low noise, a 12 W step is clearly visible on a quiet, voltage-regulated laboratory bench with a resistive baseline.

question_3_unique_appliance_attribution.evidence: On real AC distribution mains with voltage fluctuations, competing switch-mode power supplies (laptop chargers, TVs), and thermal baseline drift, a 12 W change is fundamentally ambiguous and cannot be uniquely attributed to an LED bulb without harmonic distortion metrology or dedicated submetering.

Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.architecture_summary: Analog Devices ADE9153A with custom isolated SPI front-end and ESP32 host
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.measurement_capabilities: Complete: Active, Reactive (signed), Apparent, V_RMS, I_RMS, PF, Line Freq, Half-cycle RMS, Phase Angle
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.low_power_suitability: High: 24-bit ADCs, programmable gain down to 18.4 mV RMS, and mSure autocalibration resolve sub-watt shunt signals
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.calibration_and_uncertainty: Minimal: mSure autocalibration measures shunt aging and temperature drift in-situ without external reference calibrators
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.firmware_complexity: High: Requires SPI driver with CRC-16 validation, mSure initialization state machine, and FreeRTOS tasks on ESP32
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.safety_and_isolation_requirements: Complex: Requires discrete galvanic digital isolators (ISO7741) and isolated DC-DC converter (2.5 kV RMS) on custom PCB
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.ground_truth_suitability: Excessive for simple submetering; ideal for primary aggregate mains bench front-end
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.approximate_bom_cost_usd: $45.00 - $65.00 USD (custom board with IC, isolators, DC-DC, ESP32, and shunt/CT)
Architecture_A_Integrated_IC_ADE9153A.verdict: PREFERRED ARCHITECTURE FOR RESEARCH TEST BENCH AGGREGATE SENSING

Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.architecture_summary: Peacefair PZEM-004T v3.0 pre-assembled module with onboard optocouplers and split-core CT
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.measurement_capabilities: Incomplete for Research: Active Power, V_RMS, I_RMS, Energy, Frequency, Power Factor magnitude. CRITICAL DEFECT: NO REACTIVE POWER (Q) REGISTER
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.low_power_suitability: Poor: 100A CT starting threshold is 0.02 A (~4.6 W); significant phase error below 0.2 A
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.calibration_and_uncertainty: Fixed factory calibration. Cannot correct split-core CT phase shift or calibrate zero-current offset
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.firmware_complexity: Low: Standard Modbus-RTU over 9600 bps UART using existing open-source libraries
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.safety_and_isolation_requirements: Simple: Built-in PC817 optocouplers provide safe isolation to TTL UART pins; requires only protective external enclosure
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.ground_truth_suitability: HIGH: Excellent, cost-effective isolated submeter for dedicated appliance circuits (using 10A model)
Architecture_B_Prebuilt_Module_PZEM_004T.verdict: PREFERRED ARCHITECTURE FOR APPLIANCE-LEVEL GROUND TRUTH SUBMETERING

bulb_01_12w_led.current_evidence: Milestone 2C.4 synthetic tests prove catastrophic failure (36.9 FA/hr, F1=0.018) in realistic noise
bulb_01_12w_led.supported_by_simulation_only: Detectability under ideal laboratory conditions (sigma=1.5 W, F1=0.933)
bulb_01_12w_led.what_proposed_instrument_could_measure: Active power step (+12 W), non-linear harmonic current distortion (if high-frequency front-end deployed)
bulb_01_12w_led.what_remains_unproven: Whether whole-house aggregate active power can ever isolate a 12 W step amid normal residential voltage sags
bulb_01_12w_led.experiment_to_resolve_uncertainty: Phase 2 & 4 bench metrology test using ADE9153A comparing P/V^2 normalization with and without 50W laptop charger distractors

fan_01_45w_ceiling_fan.current_evidence: Milestone 2C.4 tests show F1=0.857 in residential noise, but collapse to F1=0.216 under concurrent switching
fan_01_45w_ceiling_fan.supported_by_simulation_only: Robust separation in the absence of competing 45-65 W laptop chargers
fan_01_45w_ceiling_fan.what_proposed_instrument_could_measure: Active power step (+45 W), slight inductive phase lag (PF ~ 0.91)
fan_01_45w_ceiling_fan.what_remains_unproven: Rejection of USB-C Power Delivery laptop charger step transitions (which step 45 W to 65 W)
fan_01_45w_ceiling_fan.experiment_to_resolve_uncertainty: Phase 4 distractor test running laptop charging cycles while toggling fan speeds

pump_01_75w_water_pump.current_evidence: Milestone 2C.4 proved reactive power (Q ~ 60 VAR, PF ~ 0.78) elevates RF Event F1 from 0.087 to 0.750
pump_01_75w_water_pump.supported_by_simulation_only: Linear phasor reactive power separation against synthetic residential background
pump_01_75w_water_pump.what_proposed_instrument_could_measure: Active step (+75 W), inductive reactive surge (+60 VAR), motor startup inrush envelope
pump_01_75w_water_pump.what_remains_unproven: Accuracy of reactive power sign under non-sinusoidal voltage distortion on real Indian distribution grids
pump_01_75w_water_pump.experiment_to_resolve_uncertainty: Phase 2 & 3 bench validation with ADE9153A measuring actual motor inrush and running Q against true RMS reference DMM

heater_01_140w_water_heater.current_evidence: Proven detectable in simulation (F1 > 0.95); large resistive step (+140 W, PF = 0.99)
heater_01_140w_water_heater.supported_by_simulation_only: Clean rectangular active power pulse without thermal resistance drift
heater_01_140w_water_heater.what_proposed_instrument_could_measure: Large active step (+140 W), zero reactive displacement (Q ~ 0 VAR, PF ~ 1.00)
heater_01_140w_water_heater.what_remains_unproven: Resistance change of heating element as nichrome wire heats up from room temperature to 80 C (+/- 5 W drift)
heater_01_140w_water_heater.experiment_to_resolve_uncertainty: Phase 2 continuous 30-minute heating cycle logging active power drift over temperature

safety_and_deployment_constraints.non_energized_mandate: Zero mains voltage connections. Planning and design review milestone only. Hardware purchase and live connection strictly deferred
safety_and_deployment_constraints.software_gate: ENABLE_HARDWARE_INGEST remains FALSE in backend configuration
safety_and_deployment_constraints.galvanic_isolation: Minimum 2.5 kV RMS isolation required across digital communication boundary
safety_and_deployment_constraints.fuse_protection: 250 mA 250V fast-acting ceramic fuse required on all voltage sensing taps
safety_and_deployment_constraints.enclosure_rating: IP30 minimum, non-conductive, UL94-V0 flame-retardant housing
safety_and_deployment_constraints.qualified_supervision: All panel-level connections must be performed exclusively by a licensed electrician under OSHA / NFPA 70E Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols
